questions.question:
**Select the most appropriate word to fill in the blank and make a meaningful sentence.**

Raman exercises daily because he is preparing for a ______ in the armed forces.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is **option 4, i.e., career.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__ **

__
 
• The sentence suggests that the blank must contain **a noun** that means 'work, or occupation__', with the armed forces.
 
• Meanings of the given words:
 
 
• **occupancy- **the action or fact of occupying a place.
 
• **carrier-** a person or thing that carries, holds, or conveys something.
 
• **postage- **the sending of letters and parcels by post.
 
• **career-** an occupation undertaken for a significant period of a person's life
 
 
 
• Only **career** is appropriate here.

questions.question:
**Select the most appropriate option to substitute the underlined segment. If there is no need to substitute it, select No improvement.**

I would have definitely helped you if you had told me __why you did need the money.__

options.text: why did you need the money

questions.solution:
The correct answer is **option 2, i.e.,why you needed the money.**

The sentence uses the form '**did need**', which is inappropriate here. The verb '**did**' is used before the verb __in case of emphasis or question.__

Since the sentence does not show any such emphasis, so the correct verb form here is the __simple past tense__ '**needed'.**

Thus the rectified part is: why you **needed** the money

questions.question:
**Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank and make a grammatically correct sentence.**

Jamuna found an old necklace and ______ gold bangles in the cupboard.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is **'a pair of'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **"A pair of"*** is a quantifier that determines the quantity of a noun given after the preposition 'of'. Also, A pair of is used with two things that look the same, are the same size, and are meant to be used together.*
 
• Let's see an example-
 
 
• To help you see you wear **a pair of glasses.**
 
 

**So the correct sentence is-** Jamuna found an old necklace and **a pair of** gold bangles in the cupboard.

questions.question:

questions.solution:

Thus the correct sentence is *The student **requested** for a refund of fees.*

questions.question:
**Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank and make a grammatically correct sentence.**

Nowadays, many home buyers __________ interest in digital homes.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is **option 4, i.e., are showing.**

The given sentence contains a __plural noun__ **'buyers**', which means the corresponding verb must also reflect this.

Also, the sentence uses the adverb 'nowadays', which means 'at the present time', eliminating the possibility of any past tense verbs.

So, only simple present tense or present continuous forms of the verb are appropriate here, viz, **show** or **are showing**.

Since the sentence implies that the act of showing interest is a continuous action that is taking place nowadays, 'are showing' is the best alternative for the blank.
